blocks.text: How you make the future depends on the verb's **aspect** (next section). With an **imperfective** verb — an action seen as a process, or repeated — use **буду** + the infinitive:

A **perfective** verb — one action, done and finished — has no present tense. Its present-tense *form* means the future: **прочита́ю** = *I will read (it through)*. **Я напишу́ письмо** — *I'll write the letter.*

items: Завтра я буду читать весь день.
Tomorrow I'll be reading all day. (a process)
Tomorrow I'll read this book (to the end). (one finished act)

blocks.text: **Буду** on its own is the future of *to be*: **Я бу́ду до́ма.** *I'll be at home.*

exercises.q: Завтра мы ___ работать. (we will be working)
*I will write (and finish) the letter* — which?
exercises.why: A perfective verb's present form is its future: **напишу**. Never *буду* + a perfective infinitive.

exercises.q: Я ___ тебе завтра. (позвонить, perfective — I'll call)
